item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(request,evidence,policy,expected):\\n    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))\\n    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)\\n    assert got==expected,(got,expected)\\n    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before\\n    assert set(got)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} and len(got)==4\\n\\nr={'claim':'calibration','conditions':{'device':'A'}}\\ne=[\\n {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'calibration','value':0,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},\\n {'source':'unverified','claim':'calibration','value':0,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':False},\\n {'source':'other','claim':'other','value':0,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True}\\n]\\ncheck(r,e,{'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})\\ncheck(r,e,{'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':False},{'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['unverified'],'unknowns':[]})\\ncheck({'claim':'calibration','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':False},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['device']})\\n# An eligible record may supersede an ID; an ineligible record may not. Self-supersession is not supersession by another record.\\np={'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':True}\\ne2=[\\n {'source':'old','claim':'calibration','value':1,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True},\\n {'source':'new','claim':'calibration','value':2,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},\\n {'source':'bad','claim':'calibration','value':9,'conditions':{'device':'B'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']},\\n {'source':'self','claim':'calibration','value':2,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['self']}\\n]\\ncheck(r,e2,p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new','self'],'unknowns':[]})\\n# Canonical JSON ignores object member order but not false versus zero.\\ne3=[\\n {'source':'b','claim':'calibration','value':{'x':1,'y':[2,3]},'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True},\\n {'source':'a','claim':'calibration','value':{'y':[2,3],'x':1},'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True}\\n]\\ncheck(r,e3,p,{'status':'supported','value':{'x':1,'y':[2,3]},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})\\ne3.append({'source':'c','claim':'calibration','value':False,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True})\\ncheck(r,e3,p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','c'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nassert [evaluate(x,evidence,policy) for x in requests]==json.load(open('report.json'))\\nprint('extended checks passed')\"]}"}
